title: Why Connectors Matter
text:
Linking words help readers follow the logic of a text. They show how one idea connects to another, such as by adding information, showing contrast, or explaining a result. Without them, a paragraph can feel like a list of unrelated facts. Many learners use the same few connectors again and again, which makes their writing sound simple.

However, using a wide range of connectors does not mean using them randomly. Words such as 'therefore' signal a conclusion, while 'moreover' adds a stronger point to an argument. Writers should choose each connector carefully, because a wrong choice can confuse the reader. Practicing with short texts is a good way to notice these patterns.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what can happen to a paragraph without linking words?
options: It can feel like a list of unrelated facts
It always turns into a conclusion

questions.text: What does the word 'therefore' signal in paragraph two?
options: A contrast with a previous idea

questions.text: What can be inferred about writers who use only a few connectors?
options: Their writing may sound simple and repetitive
They read more books than other writers
They avoid using any linking words at all

questions.text: Why does the author recommend practicing with short texts?
options: To learn to notice how connectors are used
To replace the work of a teacher

vocabulary.definition: the way ideas are connected in a reasoned order
a clear difference between two ideas
for that reason; as a result
without a plan or a clear pattern

paragraph_translations: Las palabras de enlace ayudan a los lectores a seguir la lógica de un texto. Muestran cómo una idea se conecta con otra, por ejemplo al añadir información, mostrar un contraste o explicar un resultado. Sin ellas, un párrafo puede parecer una lista de datos no relacionados. Muchos estudiantes usan una y otra vez los mismos conectores, lo que hace que su escritura suene sencilla.

Sin embargo, usar una gran variedad de conectores no significa usarlos al azar. Palabras como 'therefore' indican una conclusión, mientras que 'moreover' añade un argumento más fuerte. Los escritores deben elegir cada conector con cuidado, porque una elección incorrecta puede confundir al lector. Practicar con textos cortos es una buena forma de notar estos patrones.
